fullPassage: The connectedness of the global economic market makes it vulnerable to potential "infection." A financial failure can make its way from borrowers to banks to insurers, spreading like a flu. However, there are unexpected characteristics when it comes to such infection in the market. Infection can occur even without any contact. A bank might become insolvent even without having any of its investments fail. Fear and uncertainty can be damaging to financial markets, just as cascading failures due to bad investments. If we all woke up tomorrow and believed that Bank X would be insolvent, then it would become insolvent. In fact, it would be enough for us to fear that others believed that Bank X was going to fail, or just to fear our collective fear! We might all even know that Bank X was well-managed with healthy investments, but if we expected others to pull their money out, then we would fear being the last to pull our money out. Financial distress can be self-fulfilling and is a particularly troublesome aspect of financial markets.

det.tip: can occur = 발생할 수 있다. occur = happen = 발생하다

questions.passage: The connectedness of the global economic market makes it vulnerable to potential "infection." A financial failure can make its way from borrowers to banks to insurers, spreading like a flu. However, there are unexpected characteristics when it comes to such infection in the market. Infection can occur even without any contact. A bank might become insolvent even without having any of its investments fail. __________ can be damaging to financial markets, just as cascading failures due to bad investments. If we all woke up tomorrow and believed that Bank X would be insolvent, then it would become insolvent. In fact, it would be enough for us to fear that others believed that Bank X was going to fail, or just to fear our collective fear! We might all even know that Bank X was well-managed with healthy investments, but if we expected others to pull their money out, then we would fear being the last to pull our money out. Financial distress can be self-fulfilling and is a particularly troublesome aspect of financial markets.
questions.stem:

"두려움과 불확실성"
[조건] and, Fear, uncertainty를 모두 사용할 것

det.analysis: Fear(두려움) + and + uncertainty(불확실성): 두 가지가 금융 시장에 해를 끼칠 수 있다는 본문의 핵심 주장
det.tip: fear = 두려움, uncertainty = 불확실성. 금융 위기의 비물리적 원인

questions.stem: 다음 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 부분을 고르시오.

det.analysis:
① The connectedness of the global economic market makes it vulnerable — 정상
② A financial failure can make its way from borrowers to banks — 정상
③ even without any contacts → contact (any + 불가산명사 contact. 여기서 contact는 '접촉'이라는 추상 개념) ←정답
④ Fear and uncertainty can be damaging to financial markets — 정상
det.tip: contact(접촉): 추상 개념일 때 불가산명사. any contact = 어떤 접촉도
